Alphamatician (alphamatician.com) | Data Pipeline Engineer | Remote | Full-time

We build and maintain alternative data products for institutional investors — structured datasets covering 40,000+ companies globally with up to 15 years of history, delivered via API and SFTP.

Looking for someone to own our data pipelines end-to-end: collection, cleaning, structuring, monitoring, and error resolution. You'd be working directly with the founder.

Stack: PHP (CodeIgniter 4), MySQL (AWS RDS), Python, Node.js. PHP is a hard requirement.

Apply: alphamatician.com/careers
